name: openbuild
description: Evidence-grounded specifications with user-owned product decisions, iterative blind-spot closure, bounded implementation, TDD-first delivery, and progressive review for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and review from one durable specification
interface.longDescription: Turn ideas or existing specifications into repository-grounded plans, map linked normative sources, let users choose every product-impacting outcome from explained options, apply approved decisions across the product map, route code search to a confirmed separate usage pool, exact-dispatch a risk-matched bounded writer, execute TDD-first milestones, and review through an evidence-gated sequential model ladder.
defaultPrompt: Use Build in auto mode to turn this idea into a blind-spot-checked, reviewed implementation.
Refine an existing specification against the current repository.
Execute a ready specification with progressive review.
